Intro

I'm an engineer at NVIDIA building a platform that simulates data centers. Most of my attention right now is on AI-native software development, and I think developing sound intuition for working safely and effectively with agent-first systems is becoming important for everyone.

I grew up on the Outer Banks of North Carolina and studied Mathematics at Duke. I'm very happily married to my wife, who I've been with since high school. Outside of work I spend a lot of time outdoors and I enjoy climbing, surfing, and spearfishing. I try to stay current with what's happening in AI, business, and geopolitics. I also love animals.
